    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt1,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS ext_tax1,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS net_paid1,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt2,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS ext_tax2,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS net_paid2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt3,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS ext_tax3,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS net_paid3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt4,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS ext_tax4,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS net_paid4,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt5,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS ext_tax5,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS net_paid5
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN b.cnt1 > 1071 THEN b.ext_tax1 ELSE b.net_paid1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN b.cnt2 > 39161 THEN b.ext_tax2 ELSE b.net_paid2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN b.cnt3 > 29434 THEN b.ext_tax3 ELSE b.net_paid3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN b.cnt4 > 6568 THEN b.ext_tax4 ELSE b.net_paid4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN b.cnt5 > 21216 THEN b.ext_tax5 ELSE b.net_paid5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN bucket_data AS b ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
